papers.title: Strategic Algorithmic Monoculture:Experimental Evidence from Coordination Games
papers.abstract: AI agents increasingly operate in multi-agent environments where outcomes depend on coordination. We distinguish primary algorithmic monoculture -- baseline action similarity -- from strategic algorithmic monoculture, whereby agents adjust similarity in response to incentives. We implement a simple experimental design that cleanly separates these forces, and deploy it on human and large language model (LLM) subjects. LLMs exhibit high levels of baseline similarity (primary monoculture) and, like humans, they regulate it in response to coordination incentives (strategic monoculture). While LLMs coordinate extremely well on similar actions, they lag behind humans in sustaining heterogeneity when divergence is rewarded.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】人工智能代理越来越多地在多代理环境中运行，其决策结果取决于各代理之间的协作。我们区分了两种主要的算法模式：一种是基于算法本身的“单一文化”（即代理行为之间的初始相似性）；另一种则是“策略性算法单一文化”，在这种模式下，代理会根据外部激励调整自身的行为相似性。我们设计了一个简单的实验方案，能够清晰地区分这两种机制，并将其应用于人类受试者和大型语言模型（LLM）进行测试。实验结果表明，LLM在初始阶段表现出较高的行为相似性（属于第一种模式）；与人类类似，它们也会在面临协作激励时调整自身的行为以促进多样性（即进入第二种模式）。尽管LLM在行为相似性方面能够实现高度协同，但在需要保持行为差异性的情况下，它们的表现却不如人类。。研究方法：实验方法。

papers.title: On Conservative Stable Standard of Behavior and Perfect Coalitional Equilibrium
papers.abstract: We show that in Greenberg (1989)'s coalitional repeated game situation, every nondiscriminating Conservative Stable Standard of Behavior is a subset of the set of Perfect Coalitional Equilibrium (Ali and Liu 2026) paths. Moreover, the set of Perfect Coalitional Equilibrium paths itself is a nondiscriminating Conservative Stable Standard of Behavior. The set of Perfect Coalitional Equilibrium paths is therefore the maximal nondiscriminating Conservative Stable Standard of Behavior.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】我们证明了在Greenberg（1989）提出的联盟重复博弈情境中，每一个非歧视性的保守稳定行为标准（non-discriminating Conservative Stable Standard of Behavior）都是完美联盟均衡（Perfect Coalitional Equilibrium）路径集合的子集（Ali和Liu，2026年）。此外，完美联盟均衡路径集合本身也符合非歧视性的保守稳定行为标准。因此，完美联盟均衡路径集合构成了最大的非歧视性保守稳定行为标准。。研究方法：均衡模型。

papers.title: Climate Change and Economic Performance: Empirical Evidence from West African Countries (1994-2025)
papers.venue: Asian Journal of Economics, Finance and Management
papers.summary_zh: 本文属于「绿色金融与可持续发展」领域，主题为：Climate Change and Economic Performance: Empirical Evidence from West African Countries (1994-2025)。涉及关键词：Economics、Environmental Science。原文未提供摘要，建议通过 DOI 链接查看全文以了解具体研究方法与结论。

papers.title: Integrating ESG Pressure, Risk Integration, And Digital Capability: A Strategic Framework for Sustainable Digital Banking Transformation in Emerging Markets
papers.venue: Journal of economics, finance and management studies
papers.abstract: The global banking industry is undergoing significant transformation driven by rapid digitalization and increasing sustainability challenges. Financial institutions are expected not only to adopt advanced digital technologies but also to integrate environmental, social, and governance (ESG) considerations into their strategic decision-making processes. In emerging economies such as Indonesia, these transformations occur within complex external environments shaped by regulatory developments, technological innovation, economic dynamics, and societal expectations. This study analyzes the external environmental dynamics influencing the transformation of sustainable digital banking in Indonesia using the PESTEL analytical framework. The research examines how political, economic, social, technological, environmental, and legal factors collectively shape the strategic responses of banking institutions toward digital and sustainability transformation. In addition to industry-level analysis, the study incorporates empirical insights from selected Indonesian digital banks as illustrative cases, including Bank Raya Indonesia as an illustrative case of Sustainable Digital Banking Transformation within the Indonesian financial ecosystem. The findings indicate that Sustainable Digital Banking Transformation is driven by multiple interacting environmental forces. Regulatory initiatives promoting sustainable finance, the rapid growth of ESG investment, increasing digital adoption among consumers, technological innovation in fintech ecosystems, climate-related sustainability pressures, and evolving legal frameworks collectively shape the strategic direction of the banking industry. The study contributes to the literature on strategic sustainability management by integrating Sustainable Digital Banking Transformation and sustainable finance within a comprehensive external environment framework. The findings also provide managerial insights for financial institutions seeking to align digital innovation with long-term sustainability strategies in emerging financial markets. This study proposes a multi-layered conceptual framework integrating ESG pressure, risk integration, digital capability, and green human capital to explain Sustainable Digital Banking Transformation.
papers.summary_zh: 【银行与信贷】全球银行业正在经历重大变革，这一变革主要由快速数字化进程以及日益严峻的可持续发展挑战所推动。金融机构不仅需要采用先进的数字技术，还需将环境、社会和治理（ESG）因素纳入其战略决策过程。在印度尼西亚等新兴经济体中，这些变革发生在复杂的外部环境中，这些环境受到监管政策、技术创新、经济动态和社会期望的共同影响。本研究采用PESTEL分析框架，探讨了影响印度尼西亚可持续数字银行业发展的外部环境因素。研究分析了政治、经济、社会、技术、环境和法律因素如何共同塑造银行业在数字化和可持续发展方面的战略响应。除了行业层面的分析外，研究还选取了多家印度尼西亚数字银行作为案例进行分析，其中印度尼西亚国家银行（Bank Raya Indonesia）被作为印度尼西亚金融生态系统中可持续数字银行业发展的典范。研究结果表明，可持续数字银行业的发展受到多种相互作用的外部因素的驱动：促进可持续金融的监管政策、ESG投资的快速增长、消费者对数字技术的日益依赖、金融科技领域的创新、与气候相关的可持续发展压力以及不断演变的法律框架，共同决定了银行业的战略方向。该研究通过将可持续数字银行业发展与可持续金融纳入一个全面的...。

papers.title: The Empathy Channel in Fertility -- by Sebastian Galiani, Raul A. Sosa
papers.abstract: Being around babies makes people want babies. We formalize this observation as the empathy channel: exposure to infants in the social environment activates neurobiological mechanisms that increase the desire for parenthood. As children become scarcer, this affective stimulus weakens, further eroding the motivation to have children. We embed the mechanism in a two-group overlapping-generations quantity-quality model. The empathy channel generates a positive externality, since each birth raises others’ desire for children, making the decentralized equilibrium inefficient. We characterize the optimal per-child subsidy and show that the first-order Pigouvian rate substantially overshoots the general-equilibrium optimum. The optimal targeting rule follows a Ramsey-like logic, directing the subsidy at the group with the most externality per fiscal dollar, not the group with the largest externality per child. The calibrated model suggests that the empathy channel can account for 3–33% of the fertility decline, with 13.4% at the baseline. At this baseline, the Pigouvian overshoot is 23–32% and the optimal subsidy raises welfare by 0.22% in consumption-equivalent terms.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】与婴儿接触会让人产生想要孩子的愿望。我们将这一现象称为“共情机制”：在社会环境中接触婴儿会激活某些神经生物学机制，从而增强人们成为父母的愿望。随着儿童数量的减少，这种情感刺激逐渐减弱，进一步削弱了人们生育的动机。我们将这一机制纳入一个包含两组人群、且世代重叠的数量-质量模型中进行分析。共情机制会产生正外部性，因为每个新生儿的诞生都会提高其他人对孩子的需求，从而导致分散决策下的均衡结果效率低下。我们确定了最优的儿童补贴水平，并发现一阶庇古税（Pigouvian tax）的税率会大幅超过一般均衡下的最优水平。最优的补贴分配规则遵循类似拉姆齐（Ramsey）的逻辑，即将补贴发放给每单位财政支出所产生的外部性最大的群体，而非每个孩子所产生的外部性最大的群体。根据校准后的模型预测，共情机制可以解释3%至33%的生育率下降现象；在基准情景下，这一比例约为13.4%。在该基准情景下，庇古税的超额效应为23%至32%，而最优补贴政策可使福利水平提高0.22%（以消费等值单位衡量）。。研究方法：均衡模型。

papers.title: Profit Regulation and Strategic Transfer Pricing by Vertically Integrated Firms: Evidence from Health Care -- by Pragya Kakani, Eric Yde, Genevieve P. Kanter, Richard G. Frank, Amelia M. Bond
papers.abstract: We provide evidence of strategic transfer pricing by vertically integrated health care firms in response to insurer profit regulations. Insurers increased prices at vertically integrated pharmacies by 9.5% following the introduction of caps on insurer profits in Medicare Part D. We detect larger price increases by insurers that were at greatest risk of exceeding the allowable profit level. More than one-fifth of these higher prices were borne by the federal government. Our analysis illustrates that vertically integrated firms can evade profit regulation by “tunneling” profits to unregulated subsidiaries, undermining regulatory intent and increasing health care spending.
papers.summary_zh: 【公司金融】我们提供了证据，表明垂直整合的医疗保健企业在应对保险公司利润监管时采用了战略性转让定价策略。在医疗保险D部分（Medicare Part D）实施利润上限规定后，保险公司将其在垂直整合药店中的药品价格提高了9.5%。我们发现，那些最有可能超出允许利润水平的保险公司提高了更高的价格。这些价格上涨带来的成本中，有超过五分之一由联邦政府承担。我们的分析表明，垂直整合的企业可以通过将利润“转移”至不受监管的子公司来规避利润监管，从而削弱监管效果，并增加医疗保健支出。。

papers.title: Information Intermediaries in Monopolistic Screening
papers.abstract: We investigate the relationship between product offerings, information dissemination, and consumer decision-making in a monopolistic screening environment in which consumers lack information about their valuation of quality-differentiated products. An intermediary, who is driven by the objective of maximizing consumer surplus but is also biased towards high-quality products, provides recommendations after the monopolist announces the menu of product choices. We characterize the monopolist's profit-maximizing finite-item menu. Our results show that as intermediaries place greater emphasis on consumer surplus over product quality, sellers are prompted to strategically expand their product range. Intriguingly, this augmented product variety decreases economic efficiency compared to scenarios where direct seller-to-consumer information provision is the norm. The role of information intermediaries proves pivotal in shaping consumer welfare, market profitability, and overarching economic efficiency. Our insights underscore the complexities introduced by these intermediaries that policymakers and market designers must consider when designing policies centered on consumer learning and market information transparency.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】我们研究了在垄断筛选环境下产品供应、信息传播与消费者决策之间的关系。在这种环境下，消费者无法了解自己对质量差异化产品的价值评估。中介机构的存在旨在最大化消费者剩余，但同时其对高质量产品存在偏好。在垄断者公布产品选择菜单后，中介机构会提供相应的推荐建议。我们分析了垄断者为实现利润最大化而制定的有限产品菜单的构成。研究结果表明，当中介机构更重视消费者剩余而非产品质量时，卖方会倾向于策略性地扩大产品范围。有趣的是，与直接由卖方向消费者提供信息的情形相比，这种增加的产品多样性反而降低了经济效率。信息中介机构在塑造消费者福利、市场盈利能力以及整体经济效率方面发挥着关键作用。我们的研究结果强调了这些中介机构所带来的复杂性，政策制定者和市场设计者在制定以消费者学习和市场信息透明度为核心的目标政策时必须予以充分考虑。。

papers.title: Optimal Annuitization Time under a Mortality Shock
papers.abstract: In this paper, we derive explicit closed-form solutions for the value function and the associated optimal stopping boundaries in an optimal annuitization problem under a mortality shock. We consider an individual whose retirement wealth is invested in a financial fund following the dynamics of a geometric Brownian motion and has the option at any time to irreversibly convert their wealth into a life annuity. The individual faces a sudden, permanent health deterioration occurring at a random, exponentially distributed time, and the annuitization decision is modelled as an optimal stopping problem across two health states. Our analytical expressions characterise both the value function and the optimal timing of annuitization. The results provide clear economic intuition: the optimal strategy is governed by the critical interplay between the relative attractiveness of the annuity (money's worth), the financial returns from the investment fund, and bequest motives across different health states. A numerical analysis compares the optimal annuitization strategy of an individual facing a health shock against a benchmark case with constant mortality, highlighting how the likelihood and severity of a health shock significantly alter optimal annuitization behaviour.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】在本文中，我们为在死亡率冲击下最优年金化问题中的价值函数及相关最优停止边界推导出了显式的封闭形式解。我们考虑这样一种情况：一个人的退休财富投资于一个遵循几何布朗运动规律的金融基金，并且该人可以在任何时间选择将其财富不可逆地转换为终身年金。此人面临在随机且呈指数分布的时间点发生的突然、永久性的健康状况恶化，而年金化决策被建模为一个涉及两种健康状态的最优停止问题。我们的分析表达式清晰地描述了价值函数以及年金化的最佳时机。研究结果提供了明确的经济学直觉：最优策略受到年金（货币价值）的相对吸引力、投资基金的财务回报以及不同健康状态下的遗赠动机之间的关键相互作用的影响。数值分析将面临健康冲击的个体的最优年金化策略与死亡率恒定的基准情况进行了比较，揭示了健康冲击的可能性和严重性如何显著改变最优年金化行为。。

papers.title: Optimal Market Composition In Monopoly Screening
papers.abstract: Economic institutions often influence market outcomes not by directly controlling sellers' menus, but by shaping the market composition sellers face. We study this problem in the canonical monopoly screening model. An upstream actor chooses the distribution of buyer valuations, after which a monopolist offers the optimal quality-price menu. We characterize the optimal market composition and the efficient frontier of consumer surplus and profit. If the upstream actor places at least as much weight on profits as on consumer surplus, the optimal market collapses to the top type. If the weight on consumer surplus is larger than the weight on profits, the optimal market exhibits no exclusion, no interior bunching, and a positive mass at the highest valuation. Under a mild curvature condition, the optimum is unique. As the weight on consumer surplus rises, the optimal market becomes more heterogeneous and less concentrated at the top: the interior expands while the top segment shrinks. Consumer surplus rises, profit falls, and total surplus declines.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】经济制度往往通过影响卖方所面临的市场结构来影响市场结果，而非直接控制卖方的商品定价或服务选项。我们在经典的垄断筛选模型中研究了这一问题。在这一模型中，上游参与者首先决定买方对商品或服务的估值分布，随后垄断者根据这些估值提供最优的质量-价格组合。我们分析了最优的市场结构以及消费者剩余和利润的最有效配置边界。如果上游参与者对利润的重视程度至少与对消费者剩余的重视程度相当，那么最优市场将仅包含最高质量的商品或服务（即“顶级类型”）。如果对消费者剩余的重视程度高于对利润的重视程度，最优市场将不会排斥任何消费者，不会出现内部消费者群体的聚集现象，并且在最高估值水平上仍会有消费者购买商品或服务。在满足某些温和的曲率条件时，最优解是唯一的。随着对消费者剩余重视程度的提高，最优市场将变得更加多样化，顶级市场的集中度也会降低：内部消费者群体的规模扩大，而顶级市场的规模缩小。消费者剩余会增加，利润会减少，总剩余也会随之下降。。

papers.title: The Geoeconomics of Venture Capital An Economic Complexity Approach to Emerging Technological Sovereignty
papers.abstract: We explore a quantitative approach to emerging technological sovereignty and geoeconomic power by assessing the relative positioning of countries with economic complexity methods applied to the structure of national venture-capital (VC) portfolios and their associated Revealed Venture Advantage (RVA) metrics. Using Crunchbase firm- and deal-level data, we map venture-backed startups to 18 emerging technology domains via a probabilistic multi-label large-language-model classifier, and construct an RVA-based country-technology specialization matrix for the 17 countries with the highest aggregate VC funding. From this matrix, we derive two eigenvector-based measures: a Geoeconomic Complexity Index (GCI) that ranks countries by the composition of their venture specializations, and an Emerging Technology Geoeconomic Complexity Index (ETGCI) that ranks domains by the extent to which specialization is concentrated among high-GCI countries. Empirically, Cloud Computing, Cybersecurity Tools, and Medtech exhibit the highest ETGCI values, reflecting concentration of specialization in a small set of leading countries. The United States and Israel consistently occupy a marked "high-diversity/low-ubiquity" position and lead the GCI ranking, followed by China, France, Japan, and Germany; both country and domain rankings are stable from 2021-2024. Finally, relatedness-based simulations identify, when it exists, for each country the Simplest Single Sovereignty Enhancing Technology (SSSET), i.e., the most feasible single new technological direction associated with the largest expected improvement in relative geoeconomic positioning.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】我们采用定量方法研究新兴技术主权与地缘经济实力，通过分析各国的经济复杂性来评估其相对地位。具体方法包括运用经济复杂性分析工具来分析各国风险投资（VC）投资组合的结构及其相关的“显性风险优势”（Revealed Venture Advantage, RVA）指标。利用Crunchbase平台提供的企业及交易层面的数据，我们通过概率多标签大规模语言模型将获得风险投资的初创企业映射到18个新兴技术领域，并为获得最高风险投资总额的17个国家构建了基于RVA的国家-技术专业化矩阵。基于该矩阵，我们推导出两个基于特征向量的指标：一是地缘经济复杂性指数（Geoeconomic Complexity Index, GCI），用于根据各国的风险投资专业化构成对其进行排名；二是新兴技术地缘经济复杂性指数（Emerging Technology Geoeconomic Complexity Index, ETGCI），用于评估各技术领域的专业化程度在高水平GCI国家中的集中程度。实证研究表明，云计算、网络安全工具和医疗技术领域的ETGCI值最高，表明这些领域的技术专业化主要集中在少数领先国家。美国和以...。研究方法：数值模拟。

papers.title: Is Bitcoin A Hedge Against Central Banking? Evidence from AI-Driven Monetary Policy Expectations
papers.abstract: This study investigates the transmission of monetary policy narratives to Bitcoin prices, distinguishing the impact of ex-ante expectations from ex-post interest rate implementation. We introduce a high-frequency Monetary Policy Expectations (MPE) index, using a Large Language Model (LLM)-based classification of 118,000+ market messages to achieve a precise hawkish/dovish decomposition. Results from a framework combining Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) networks with SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP) indicate that Bitcoin functions as a sensitive barometer of central bank signaling; specifically, hawkish narratives consistently trigger negative price responses independently of actual Federal Funds Rate adjustments. We demonstrate that the MPE index Granger-causes Bitcoin returns at short-to-medium horizons, establishing linear predictive causality, while the LSTM-SHAP framework reveals pronounced non-linear, macroeconomic regime-dependent interactions. These findings highlight Bitcoin's structural sensitivity to global monetary discourse, establishing LLM-derived sentiment as a potent leading macroeconomic indicator for the digital asset landscape.
papers.summary_zh: 【银行与信贷】本研究探讨了货币政策信息对比特币价格的影响机制，区分了事前预期与事后利率实际实施所带来的不同效应。我们构建了一个高频货币政策预期（MPE）指数，通过基于大型语言模型（LLM）对118,000多条市场信息进行分类，实现了对货币政策立场（鹰派/鸽派）的精准判断。结合长短期记忆网络（LSTM）与Shapley加性解释（SHAP）的分析结果表明，比特币能够有效反映中央银行的货币政策信号；具体而言，鹰派言论会引发比特币价格的负面反应，且这种反应与联邦基金利率的实际调整无关。研究进一步证实，在短期至中期时间范围内，MPE指数能够对比特币价格产生格兰杰因果关系（即MPE指数变化能够预测比特币价格变化），同时LSTM-SHAP框架揭示了比特币价格与宏观经济环境之间存在显著的、非线性的交互作用。这些发现凸显了比特币对全球货币政策讨论的敏感性，表明基于LLM模型得出的市场情绪分析是评估数字货币市场的重要宏观经济指标。。

papers.title: Assessing the effectiveness of Greenblatt’s Magic Formula across international stock markets: Literature review
papers.venue: Research Papers in Economics and Finance
papers.abstract: This article presents a comprehensive literature review assessing the effectiveness of Joel Greenblatt’s Magic Formula in international equity markets. The strategy is a value-investing approach based on return on capital (ROC) and earnings yield (EY) metrics. Its primary objectives are to evaluate whether the strategy generates excess returns and to identify factors influencing its performance. The analysis synthesises empirical studies from the US, European (primarily Nordic), Brazilian and Asian markets, incorporating methodological considerations such as data sources, investment universes and systematic biases (e.g. look-ahead bias and survivorship bias). Key findings reveal that the Magic Formula outperforms benchmarks in most markets; however, its effectiveness is contingent on transaction costs (frequently eroding alpha), firm size, market conditions and metric modifications. Simpler strategies (e.g. those relying solely on EY) occasionally yield superior results. The review concludes that the Magic Formula represents a robust, albeit imperfect, tool for exploiting stock market inefficiencies. Future research directions include analyses of post-2020 periods, formula modifications and hybrid approaches.
papers.summary_zh: 【绿色金融与可持续发展】本文对Joel Greenblatt提出的“神奇公式”在国际股票市场中的有效性进行了全面的文献综述。该策略是一种基于资本回报率（ROC）和收益收益率（EY）的价值投资方法，其主要目的是评估该策略是否能够产生超额回报，并识别影响其表现的因素。研究综合了来自美国、欧洲（主要是北欧国家）、巴西和亚洲市场的实证研究，同时考虑了数据来源、投资范围以及系统性偏差（如前瞻性偏差和生存偏差）等方法学问题。关键研究发现，“神奇公式”在大多数市场中均优于基准指数；然而，其有效性受到交易成本（常常会侵蚀超额回报）、企业规模、市场条件以及指标调整等因素的影响。一些较为简单的策略（例如仅依赖收益收益率的策略）偶尔也能取得更好的投资结果。综述认为，“神奇公式”是一种可靠但并不完美的工具，可用于利用股票市场的非有效性。未来的研究方向包括对2020年之后的市场进行分析、对公式进行改进，以及探索混合投资策略。。
